objective: Replicate the constraint-decay phenomenon (Dente et al., arXiv 2605.06445): a fixed API under an increasing structural-constraint ladder (L0 framework -> L1 +architecture -> L2 +SQLite -> L3 +Sequelize ORM), 0-shot per level. Test whether using the ShapeLang skill reduces the decay vs a vanilla control.

levels.L3: L2 + Sequelize ORM for all data access.

conditions.control: Vanilla coding agent given the spec + the level's structural constraints. Codex runs with an isolated CODEX_HOME so it cannot discover ShapeLang.
conditions.shapelang: Same agent + same constraints, told to use the ShapeLang skill (reads SKILL.md, maintains shape/*.shape, runs shp).

metrics: Dual, per the paper: behavioral Assert% (blind oracle) AND static architecture/DB/ORM verifier compliance; plus shp conformance for the shapelang arm. Decay = metric(L0) - metric(L3). See docs/preregistration.md.
validation: bun run verify-rig must pass before any result is believed: golden references score 1.0 behavioral + structural at L0/L3; a behavioral mutant and a structural mutant are each caught. Each task has tasks/<id>/reference/ as a positive control and src/behaviors/<id>.ts as the blind oracle.

tasks.domain: Coupon budget and per-user limit accounting
